title: Solana programs with a known answer (white-box audit)
description: One sound Anchor program and five with a planted flaw, as source. Mynt lays each sample over the coding agents' starter program so it is a whole workspace, runs static analysis on it, and gives it to the auditor without Mynt's hard-rule results. A bad sample passes only when the auditor reports a critical or high finding whose quote Mynt finds in the named file; the good sample passes only when no verified critical or high finding is reported against it. Three bad samples are the mainnet gate's hard-rule fixtures; two have an access-control flaw; the good one is the coding agents' starter program.

tasks.description: The coding agents' own Anchor starter: a ledger that records entries and moves no value. Nothing in it should block.

tasks.planted: A hard-coded key can rewrite any ledger, and a ledger authority can be handed to an account that never signed.
Closing a ledger pays its lamports to an account the caller names, which never signs.
A vault that moves tokens out of a program-owned token account: a value-moving program.
Handing a ledger over compares the named authority with the stored one but never makes it sign, so anyone can take any ledger.
Resetting a ledger takes any signer: the ledger isn't matched to the signer, so anyone can wipe any ledger's count.
